0022600223.text: The Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East) visit the Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, 12th in the West) for Brooklyn's 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with Brooklyn on a two-game losing streak and New Orleans on three. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise), while Mikel Brown Jr. (illness) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness) are day-to-day, with Traore a game-time decision. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (out, ankle) and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and also a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Nets' last meeting was a 116-113 loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
